name: use_resource
description: Spends or restores uses of a named resource pool on a character or NPC (e.g. Rage, Ki, Channel Divinity, Action Surge). Use action 'use' when the resource is spent and 'restore' when recovering uses outside of a rest (e.g. a feature that grants a resource back).

entity_type.description: Whether the entity is a player character or NPC.

entity.description: Slug or UUID of the character or NPC.

resource_name.description: Name of the resource to spend or restore (must match an entry in the entity's resources array exactly).

amount.description: Number of uses to spend or restore. Defaults to 1.

action.description: Whether to spend ('use') or recover ('restore') uses. Defaults to 'use'.
